title: SqliteAuditReportStore tests fail due to missing work_items FK dependency
rationale: SqliteAuditReportStoreTests (8 tests) fail with 'no such table: main.work_items' because the store's CreateAsync inserts with a JOIN or FK reference to work_items before the work item is created in the same test DB. The test setup needs to either create a work item first or the store should handle the missing FK gracefully in tests.

title: BudgetAlertService in-memory state resets on restart — consider persisting last-seen state in SQLite
rationale: By design, BudgetAlertService re-fires budget events on every restart (documented in RestartReevaluatesTests). This is a deliberate trade-off, but it means webhook receivers must be idempotent. A future improvement could persist the last-seen BudgetThresholdState per project in a SQLite table so restarts don't replay events, reducing noise for long-running services.

title: ProjectBudgetEndpoints: pause/resume should fire webhook events with project context
rationale: The manual pause/resume API endpoints currently fire no webhook event. Adding project.queue_paused and project.queue_resumed webhook events for manual operator actions (in addition to the auto-pause from BudgetAlertService) would improve auditability and allow downstream consumers to react to both automatic and manual queue state changes.
